function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values — rows may not be one-per-entity", "implication": "The data contains multiple rows per patient (due to re-testing), so raw row counts or averages over rows would overcount re-tested patients. The correct population is one patient per `patient_id`, so we must deduplicate by keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each `patient_id`. This changes the analysis: we must group by `patient_id` and take the max `sample_seq` row before computing any mean."}
function.name: note_finding
